collection.title: Audi S6 Saloon 2012 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Audi S6 2012 to 2018 model requires a 26" wiper blade for the drivers and a 21" wiper blade for the passengers side with a Slim Push Button arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle.
